svg.title: Fictional gummy bottle serving and container math
svg.desc: Container arithmetic schematic; not pediatric dosing advice.
svg.text: Servings per container when the serving is two gummies
Bottle: 60 gummies · Serving Size: 2 gummies · Declared melatonin: 3 mg per serving
Servings per container = 60 ÷ 2 = 30 (cannot omit the line)
Assay vs label is a COA / literature question (Cohen JAMA 2023) — not a dose-efficacy claim
Fictional math for container literacy · piece 40
Original typeset diagram · educational only · not a photograph of a real SKU label
